newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 rises for 2nd straight session.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 rises for 2nd straight session.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index edged higher for the second straight session on Thursday but dealers once again warned that the current rebound is based on low volumes and that the risk of a downturn still remains strong.
The PX50 rose 2.8 points, 0.5 percent, to 559.5 while the RPIX closed up 10.5 points, 0.9 percent, to 1,173.5.
"The market is pretty quiet and I don't think we should draw many conclusions from it (the rise)...I expect the market could go down a bit further," said Daniel Gladis of Atlantik Financni Trhy.
Thursday's rise was spearheaded by major issues.
SPT Telecom rose five crowns to 3,445, CEZ rose 15 crowns to 1,075, Komercni Banka gained 25 crowns to 2,455 and Ceska Sporitelna rose one crown to 306.
Overall, volume fell below one million pieces while turnover was stable at around one billion crowns.
